motif: Every building is banded with riveted dark-iron ribs and carries one small Âmbar de Nevasca lamp glowing in the snow, with a snow-loaded lean-to cap.

buildings.why: Narrow truss topped by a landing ring. The ring is the read, not a tower.

buildings.archetype: spired cluster of two or three peaks
buildings.why: Three caps on a tripod with an upturned tube give a clear cluster of peaks.
A long hall with a derrick spine. The derrick is the only vertical.
Same archetype as Ice Claws. The spiral teeth grow inside a well cage, now taller and twisted.
The race's one diagonal tube on a rail truck.
Snowy Rocks chain grown to an irregular pyramid with a straight industrial cut.
Frost Launcher chain: two parallel diagonal tubes, so a wider and heavier lean.
Three ice teeth in an open well cage, ringed by a snow cone, read as a pit with a rim.
A labor dormitory dome with ribs and a chimney.
Same dome chain, repainted, with a scrap totem as the single vertical.
Snowy Rocks chain: the outcrop with a whalebone arch, a middle step toward the Glacier.
An A-frame firing tower with a downward drill point. It is the only true tall tower.
A crooked block drum with a stovepipe. The Troll Hut keeps the dome archetype.
Igloo chain grown into a taller, stiffer armored drum with a still shed attached.
A fan of ice fractures spreading from a pipe forms a low star.
Base of the chain: a low pile of stones, the most discreet building. It grows into the Glacier.
Three bottles carry a manifold across their tops like a span on legs, with the gauge face on it.
